submissionChannels.name: Creator Start
submissionChannels.title: Creator Start • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: The creator journey of the players, they submit add some details
details: Old Account — provide the name of your old account.
Creator Start Date — the date you officially started your creator journey.
Rejoining Date — the date you rejoined the creator community. If not applicable, write N/A.
submissionChannels.example:
Old Account: IrisSseries
Creator Start: December 25, 1969
Rejoining: January 1, 1970
submissionChannels.reminder: Please make sure all information is accurate before submitting.

submissionChannels.name: Member Start
submissionChannels.title: Member Start • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: Submit your LMP name and the date you officially joined the LMP community.
details: LMP Name — your account name should include LMP.
Joining Date — the date you officially joined the LMP community.
submissionChannels.example:
LMP Name: LMP.sharmaine
Joining Date: August 12, 2026
submissionChannels.reminder: Please make sure all information is accurate before submitting.

submissionChannels.name: Honor of kings profile
submissionChannels.title: HOK Profile • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: Submit a screenshot of your own Honor of Kings account profile.
details: Attach a screenshot of your own Honor of Kings profile.
Image attachment required; text-only messages do not count.
submissionChannels.example: Attach a screenshot of your own Honor of Kings profile.

submissionChannels.name: Social Media Accounts
submissionChannels.title: Accounts Profile • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: Submit your social media account names, platforms, and corresponding screenshots.
details: Social Media — platform name, such as TikTok, Facebook, or YouTube.
If you have multiple accounts, include all of them in one message with their corresponding screenshots.
submissionChannels.example:
Account Name: Airisu
Social Media: Facebook

Account Name: LMP.ꪖirisʊ≽
Social Media: Tiktok

Attach the corresponding screenshot(s) to this same message.
submissionChannels.reminder: If you have multiple accounts, include them all in one submission with their corresponding screenshots.

submissionChannels.name: Social Media Links
submissionChannels.title: Accounts Link • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: Submit the links to your social media accounts.
details: If you have multiple accounts, include all their links in one message.
submissionChannels.reminder: Submit only your social media account links. If you have multiple accounts, include all links in one submission.

submissionChannels.name: Social Media Username
submissionChannels.title: Accounts Username • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: Submit the usernames for your social media accounts.
details: Social Media — platform name, such as TikTok, Facebook, or YouTube.
Username — your username on that platform.
If you have multiple accounts, include all usernames with their corresponding platforms in one message.
submissionChannels.example:
Social Media: Tiktok
Username: @airisu_des

Social Media: Facebook
Username: @airisudes
submissionChannels.reminder: If you have multiple social media accounts, include all usernames with their corresponding platforms in one submission.

submissionChannels.name: Main Hero
submissionChannels.title: Signature Hero • Attendance
submissionChannels.description: Submit your signature hero information and an image of your main hero for your banner.
details: Hero Name — the name of your signature hero.
Request — describe the changes you want to your hero picture. If you do not want changes, write N/A.
Hero Image — attach an image of your hero using the classic/default hero model only. Skins are not allowed.
submissionChannels.example:
Hero Name: Kong Kong'er
Request: Add some devil smiles or ego looks.

Attach the classic/default hero image to this same message.
submissionChannels.reminder: Only default hero. No skins allowed; classic hero model only.
